lines.text: Early in the morning, the Jews led Jesus to the Praetorium but stayed outside, so Pilate came out.
Jesus told Pilate that His kingdom was not of this world and that He came to testify to the truth.
Pilate offered to release the King of the Jews at the Passover, but the Jews shouted for Silas.
Pilate had Jesus flogged, and the soldiers crowned Him with thorns and dressed Him in a white robe.
The chief priests said they had no king but Caesar, and Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified.
